prompt: My OTP says invalid and I cannot open the app on this device. Tell me what to try in order, and if it still fails create a support request with the technical context you can see.
actualResponse:
I can't see your device, the OTP system, or your account from here — so these are the standard checks, in the order I'd try them. Then, as you asked, I'll set up the support request if it still fails.

**Try these in order:**

1. **Use only the newest code.** If you tapped "resend" even once, older codes are usually invalidated — only the most recent one works. Type it manually; autofill can sneak in spaces.
2. **Check your device clock.** OTPs are time-based — if the device's clock is off by a few minutes, a perfectly valid code reads as invalid. Set date & time to automatic, then request a fresh code and enter it promptly.
3. **Confirm the delivery route.** Make sure the code is being sent to the email/phone linked to your account, and check spam/junk if it's email.
4. **Bypass the app.** The platform is browser-based — every link we use opens in a browser — so try opening it in a browser on this device, or on another device, while the app is misbehaving.
5. **If the app won't open at all on this device:** update it, restart the device, or reinstall it — and use another device in the meantime if you have one.

**If it still fails** — say so and I'll create a **support handoff**. Here's exactly the technical context I can see and will include:

- Your report: OTP returns "invalid" and the app won't open on your device
- Your account: paid learner, OET Medicine, UK
- Date of the report

What I *can't* see: your device model, OS, app version, or any error text — if you give me those (or the exact wording of the error), I'll add them so support has the full picture. If you'd rather I send it right now instead of after you've tried the steps, just say so.
